init_mesh_random: create a Meshes object with N random meshes having random vertices and faces
init_simple_mesh: create a Meshes object with three simple predefined mesh examples for testing
mesh_structures_equal: test whether two Meshes objects have identical verts_list, faces_list, and normals
to_sorted: create a new Meshes object with vertices sorted alphabetically and faces remapped accordingly
init_cube_meshes: create a Meshes object with four translated unit cubes for submesh testing
